---
name: "Scoped proposal / 功能建议"
about: "Propose a specific research workflow or a bounded improvement."
title: "[Proposal] "
labels: enhancement
---

## User problem / 使用问题

Who needs this, and what cannot be completed with the existing catalogue?

## Example requests and result / 问题与结果示例

Give 3–5 requests and an explicitly synthetic expected output. Do not claim live API access or guaranteed investment results.

## Data, access and cost / 数据、权限与成本

What inputs or sources are needed? Can they be shared? Does this require an account, a paid request or a third-party license? Unknowns are acceptable; mark them.

## Acceptance criteria and exclusions / 验收与不做的范围

How could this be tested without production credentials or real customer data? What is intentionally out of scope?

## Contribution / 参与方式

Can you help with documentation, tests or implementation? Opening an issue does not promise acceptance or a release date.
